verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Homebrew installs each package into a per-package keg in a global Cellar and symlinks it into the prefix. That is a single global install location, not a documented content-addressable store that deduplicates identical dependency versions across projects, so it earns no credit as an adjacent feature. missing for 10: a documented content-addressable or hash-keyed store, cross-project deduplication of identical dependency versions, and any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a shared content-addressable store so the same dependency version is stored once on disk across all projects

citations.quote: It installs each package into its own keg inside the Cellar, then symlinks its files into the prefix
